observations.subject: vomiting
observations.description: One vomiting episode after breakfast; dog remains alert, is breathing normally, and has no observed collapse, bleeding, seizure, or suspected exposure.

assessment.rationale: Current guardian evidence reports one episode without supplied emergency signs; diagnosis remains with the veterinarian.

careCalendar.instruction: Ask the veterinarian to reconcile the preventive record during the next visit; do not infer that any vaccination is due or complete.
stopConditions: The veterinarian supplies a superseding record
An urgent or emergency sign appears

monitoring.measure: Record additional vomiting, water intake, alertness, breathing, mobility, and possible exposure without assigning a diagnosis.
monitoring.successCriteria: No additional episode or new concerning sign is observed before the veterinary call.
monitoring.escalationCriteria: Repeated vomiting, inability to retain water, breathing change, collapse, severe pain, blood, seizure, possible toxin, medication error, or rapid decline.

plan.serviceScope: Veterinary examination for reported vomiting and preventive-record reconciliation; no treatment authorization.
plan.cancellationTerms: No fee when cancelled at least 24 hours before the appointment.
